module: Small utility to know whether the editor's axis gizmo is drawn. A tool calls gizmoDrawCalled() every frame it draws the gizmo; on the next frame, if nobody drew it any more, the module deselects the gizmo element on the engine side (setAxisGizmoSelectedElement(-1)).
usage:
-- in the onEditorGui of a tool that draws the gizmo
editor_gizmoHelper.gizmoDrawCalled()
if editor_gizmoHelper.isGizmoVisible() then ... end
notes: isGizmoVisible reflects the previous frame (gizmoDrawnLastFrame), not the current frame.

gizmoDrawCalled.desc: To be called from a tool every frame it draws the axis gizmo; marks the gizmo as drawn for the current frame.

isGizmoVisible.desc: Indicates whether the gizmo was drawn in the previous frame.

returns.desc: true if gizmoDrawCalled was called in the previous frame

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame by the editor: if the gizmo was drawn in the previous frame but not in this one, deselects the gizmo element (-1); then shifts the frame flag and resets it to false.
